featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing! We went to buy skates at the Decathlon Malad store and returned home with states as well as one skateboard. This cleared all the doubts I had about skateboarding as in if it’s not very hard etc. Overall, it was a superb experience and his helpful advice made the difference between me buying the skateboard there and then and that too with peace of mind.

featured_reviews.name: Raghav Kabra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience at Decathlon. The staff was extremely helpful and patient, especially Sai, who took the time to help me choose the correct size based on proper measurements rather than guesswork.
They explained the fit, comfort, and usage of the product clearly and also guided me on alternative options that suited my needs better. I appreciated the honest suggestions instead of being pushed toward unnecessary purchases.
The overall store experience was smooth—well-organized layout, good product knowledge, and a professional attitude from the team. Customer support like this genuinely makes a difference and builds trust.

featured_reviews.name: Shrirang Nikumbh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Water Sports section at Decathlon Malad with a friend to purchase some swimming items, and I wanted to share the great experience we had with the team there.
From the moment we entered the section, the staff were very welcoming and helpful. A special thanks to Sai and Noel from the team who assisted us during our visit. Both of them were extremely friendly, patient, and knowledgeable about the products. They took the time to understand what we were looking for and guided us through the available options in a very professional way.
What I really appreciated was how clearly they explained the differences between the products, their quality, and which ones would suit our needs best. Instead of rushing us into buying something, they made sure we understood the features and uses of each item. Their honest suggestions and product knowledge made the entire experience very comfortable.
Even though the store had other customers, Sai and Noel still made sure we felt attended to and answered all our questions patiently. They also gave us useful tips about using and maintaining the products, which showed that they genuinely care about helping customers make the right purchase.
The Waterworks section was well organized and easy to explore, and the positive attitude of the team made the whole visit enjoyable for both me and my friend.
Overall, it was a very pleasant shopping experience at Decathlon Malad. A big thank you to Sai, Noel, and the entire Waterworks team for their excellent service and support. Experiences like this make customers want to come back again.
